game.title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
game.blurb: Open-world stealth action game in which Venom Snake seeks revenge and builds up Mother Base, from Kojima Productions, released 2015-09-01. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but only three subpages exist: Table of Contents (about 21,000 characters, a long list of mission and Side Op names), Achievements and trophies, and Controls. The Walkthrough and every mission and Side Op page it links (such as "Prologue: Awakening", "Phantom Limbs", "Where do the bees sleep?") are not written, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and not used. metalgear.fandom.com answers the API, with about 193 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema has an empty game name; the store list confirms app 287700. 14 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden. "Trusty Steed", "Man's Best Friend" and "War Buddy" sit right after the D-Dog and Quiet achievements, so they were put in the buddies chapter by schema position; "Deterrence" and "Disarmament" (about 4 percent) sit among the Mother Base ones and were put there by position. Both placements need checking. The other 9 hidden ones ("Caravan" to "Truth", plus "Collector", "Reminiscence" and "Hero") sit in the main story chapter; "Collector" (2.4 percent) is probably not story.
